description: This file defines Swagger API schemas for the SelfLoans API resource in the Apache Fineract project. It contains nested classes representing request and response objects, including detailed schemas for loan status, type, currency, timeline, disbursement details, charges, and transaction responses. It's primarily used for API documentation and serialization/deserialization of API payloads.

classes.name: SelfLoansApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing various request and response schemas for SelfLoans API endpoints, including loan details, timeline, disbursements, charges, transactions, and templates.
